items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Ray Lopez had told me his father was a good violin player.

ctx.x: He did, yeah. Oh, yeah, yeah. He faked? Yeah, he was fake. He was good in his days at that time. Yeah. I'm talking about many. Oh, my. Right before 1900, 1800, 1890.

Ray Lopez had told me his father was a good violin player. He was in the French Opera orchestra. Yes, in the violin player, I think. I think he played trumpet, too. I don't know. I played something. I'm not real sure. No, I was.
Tell me something. Is Jules Casdard living yet?
